<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>FMWIF - Future Minds World Innovative Forum</title>
<style>
body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#10233f;background:#fff}
header{background:#f8dfe8;color:#071b35;text-align:center;padding:30px}
.logo{width:130px;border-radius:50%}
h1,h2{color:#d4af37}
nav{background:#d4af37;text-align:center;padding:12px}
section{max-width:1000px;margin:auto;padding:25px}
.box{background:#f4f6f8;padding:25px;border-radius:12px;margin:20px 0}
.speaker{width:220px;border-radius:12px}
footer{background:#071b35;color:white;text-align:center;padding:20px}
.signature-image{max-width:420px;max-width:420px;width:90%;height:auto;display:block;margin:20px auto;}
/* Digital signature */
.digital-signature{font-family:"Brush Script MT","Segoe Script","Lucida Handwriting",cursive;font-size:34px;font-style:italic;color:#10233f;margin:12px 0 4px;line-height:1.1}
/* Upcoming Event */
.upcoming-event{position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center}
.upcoming-event h2{animation:eventGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block}
.upcoming-event-image{display:block;width:100%;max-width:720px;height:auto;margin:15px auto 0;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(7,27,53,.18);animation:eventPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;cursor:pointer}
.upcoming-event::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-75%;width:45%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.55),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:eventShine 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes eventGlow{0%,100%{opacity:.72;text-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(212,175,55,0)}50%{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(212,175,55,.75)}}
@keyframes eventPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.012)}}
@keyframes eventShine{0%{left:-75%}55%,100%{left:130%}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.upcoming-event h2,.upcoming-event-image,.upcoming-event::after{animation:none}}
/* Readability improvements */
.box p, .box li, .box span, .box div {color:#10233f !important}
.card-content p {color:#10233f !important}
.header p {color:#10233f !important}
/* Final founder identity */
.founder-final .founder-signature{
text-align:center;
margin-top:28px;
padding-top:10px;
}
.founder-final .founder-name{
font-size:32px;
font-weight:800;
color:#10233f;
letter-spacing:.3px;
}
.founder-final .founder-title{
margin-top:8px;
font-size:17px;
font-weight:700;
color:#b18a18;
}
.founder-final .digital-signature{
display:inline-block;
margin-top:14px;
font-family:"Brush Script MT","Segoe Script","Lucida Handwriting",cursive;
font-size:38px;
font-weight:500;
color:#10233f;
transform:rotate(-3deg);
letter-spacing:1px;
}
@media (max-width:600px){
.founder-final .founder-name{font-size:27px}
.founder-final .founder-title{font-size:15px}
.founder-final .digital-signature{font-size:32px}
}
/* Clear founder identity above every signature */
.founder-final .founder-name{color:#6A3FB5 !important;opacity:1 !important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.founder-final .founder-title{color:#C58A00 !important;opacity:1 !important}
/* Strong visibility for Zarqa Zulfiqar identity */
.zarqa-name{
color:#071b35 !important;
font-size:32px !important;
font-weight:800 !important;
opacity:1 !important;
visibility:visible !important;
text-shadow:none !important;
}
.zarqa-signature{
color:#071b35 !important;
opacity:1 !important;
visibility:visible !important;
}
</style>
<style id="partners-collaborations-style">
.partners-section{padding:80px 24px 70px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8f6f0 0%,#fff 100%);text-align:center}
.partners-section .section-heading span{display:inline-block;color:#b18a18;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.partners-section .section-heading h2{margin:8px 0 42px;color:#142a48;font-size:34px}
.partner-block{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto 55px}
.partner-block h3{margin:0 0 7px;color:#6c42b8;font-size:25px}
.partner-block p{margin:0 0 24px;color:#667085}
.partner-grid{display:grid;gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.partner-grid-two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));max-width:760px;margin:auto}
.collaboration-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.partner-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(20,42,72,.10);border-radius:18px;min-height:150px;padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(20,42,72,.07);text-decoration:none}
.partner-card img{max-width:100%;width:auto;height:82px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.partner-grid-two .partner-card img{height:100px}
.partner-card span{margin-top:14px;color:#142a48;font-weight:800;font-size:16px}
.partner-card small{margin-top:4px;color:#b18a18;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:800px){.collaboration-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:520px){.partners-section{padding:60px 16px}.partners-section .section-heading h2{font-size:28px}.partner-grid-two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.collaboration-grid{gap:12px}.partner-card{min-height:125px;padding:16px}.partner-card img,.partner-grid-two .partner-card img{height:68px}}
</style>
<style id="contact-links-style">
.contact-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.contact-links a{display:inline-block;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.contact-links .facebook-link{background:#1877f2}
.contact-links .whatsapp-link{background:#25d366}
.contact-links .email-link{background:#6c42b8}
</style>
<style id="floating-contact-links-style">
.floating-contact-links{
position:fixed;
right:20px;
bottom:20px;
z-index:99999;
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:10px;
}
.floating-contact-links a{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
min-width:125px;
padding:12px 16px;
border-radius:999px;
color:#fff !important;
text-decoration:none !important;
font-weight:700;
box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.floating-contact-links .facebook-link{background:#1877f2}
.floating-contact-links .whatsapp-link{background:#25d366}
.floating-contact-links .email-link{background:#6c42b8}
@media (max-width:600px){
.floating-contact-links{right:12px;bottom:12px}
.floating-contact-links a{min-width:110px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:14px}
}
</style>
<style id="fmwif-modern-animation">
/* ===== FMWIF MODERN ANIMATION LAYER ===== */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{overflow-x:hidden}
/* Animated hero */
header{
position:relative;
overflow:hidden;
isolation:isolate;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8dfe8,#fff8fb 45%,#f7efd4);
animation:heroFade .9s ease both;
}
header::before,header::after{
content:"";
position:absolute;
border-radius:50%;
pointer-events:none;
z-index:-1;
}
header::before{
width:280px;height:280px;right:-90px;top:-120px;
background:rgba(212,175,55,.20);
animation:floatOrb 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
header::after{
width:220px;height:220px;left:-90px;bottom:-120px;
background:rgba(108,66,184,.12);
animation:floatOrb 9s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
}
header .logo{
transition:transform .5s ease,box-shadow .5s ease;
box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(20,42,72,.18);
animation:logoIn 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
header .logo:hover{transform:rotate(4deg) scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(20,42,72,.28)}
header h1{animation:titleIn .8s .15s both}
header h2{animation:titleIn .8s .28s both}
header p{animation:titleIn .8s .4s both}
/* Sticky animated navigation */
nav{
position:sticky;
top:0;
z-index:1000;
box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(7,27,53,.14);
backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
transition:box-shadow .3s ease,transform .3s ease;
}
nav:hover{box-shadow:0 7px 24px rgba(7,27,53,.22)}
/* Reveal cards/sections on scroll */
.box,.partner-card,.speaker,.upcoming-event{
transition:transform .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease,opacity .6s ease;
}
.box:hover{
transform:translateY(-5px);
box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(20,42,72,.12);
}
.partner-card:hover{
transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.015);
box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(20,42,72,.16);
}
.partner-card img{transition:transform .45s ease}
.partner-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.speaker{
transition:transform .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease;
box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(20,42,72,.12);
}
.speaker:hover{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.025);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(20,42,72,.20)}
h2{transition:text-shadow .35s ease,transform .35s ease}
h2:hover{transform:translateX(3px);text-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(212,175,55,.28)}
.contact-links a,.floating-contact-links a{
transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,filter .25s ease;
}
.contact-links a:hover,.floating-contact-links a:hover{
transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.03);
box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
filter:brightness(1.06);
}
/* Signature polish */
.signature-image{
transition:transform .5s ease,filter .5s ease;
}
.signature-image:hover{transform:scale(1.025) rotate(-.5deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(20,42,72,.18))}
/* Floating contact buttons */
.floating-contact-links{animation:contactIn .8s 1s both}
.floating-contact-links a:nth-child(1){animation:buttonFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.floating-contact-links a:nth-child(2){animation:buttonFloat 4s .7s ease-in-out infinite}
.floating-contact-links a:nth-child(3){animation:buttonFloat 4s 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
/* Footer */
footer{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
footer::before{
content:"";
position:absolute;left:-20%;top:0;width:40%;height:2px;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#d4af37,transparent);
animation:footerShine 4s linear infinite;
}
/* Accessible reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
*,*::before,*::after{
animation-duration:.01ms!important;
animation-iteration-count:1!important;
scroll-behavior:auto!important;
transition-duration:.01ms!important;
}
}
@keyframes heroFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes logoIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.75) rotate(-8deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes titleIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes floatOrb{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}50%{transform:translate3d(-18px,22px,0)}}
@keyframes contactIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(35px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes buttonFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes footerShine{0%{left:-40%}100%{left:120%}}
</style>
<style id="fmwif-upcoming-two-posters">
.upcoming-posters{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
gap:24px;
align-items:stretch;
max-width:1200px;
margin:18px auto 0;
}
.upcoming-poster-card{
background:#fff;
border:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.65);
border-radius:18px;
padding:10px;
box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(7,27,53,.15);
overflow:hidden;
transition:transform .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease;
}
.upcoming-poster-card:hover{
transform:translateY(-7px) scale(1.01);
box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(7,27,53,.24);
}
.upcoming-poster-card img{
width:100%;
height:auto;
max-height:760px;
object-fit:contain;
display:block;
border-radius:12px;
cursor:pointer;
animation:eventPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@media(max-width:800px){
.upcoming-posters{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
.upcoming-poster-card img{max-height:none}
}
</style>
<style id="fmwif-top-contact-buttons">
.fmwif-top-contact{
position:fixed!important; top:12px!important; right:18px!important;
z-index:10001!important; display:flex!important; gap:8px!important;
align-items:center!important;
animation:fmwifBlink 1.7s ease-in-out infinite!important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact a{
display:inline-flex!important; align-items:center!important;
justify-content:center!important; min-height:42px!important;
padding:9px 13px!important; border-radius:999px!important;
font-weight:700!important; text-decoration:none!important;
box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.22)!important;
animation:fmwifPulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite!important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact a:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.18s!important}
.fmwif-top-contact a:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.36s!important}
@keyframes fmwifBlink{
0%,100%{opacity:1;filter:brightness(1)}
50%{opacity:.45;filter:brightness(1.35)}
}
@keyframes fmwifPulse{
0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}
50%{transform:scale(1.08)}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
.fmwif-top-contact{top:8px!important;right:8px!important;right:8px!important;left:auto!important;justify-content:flex-end!important;gap:5px!important}
.fmwif-top-contact a{min-height:36px!important;padding:7px 9px!important;font-size:12px!important}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
.fmwif-top-contact,.fmwif-top-contact a{animation:none!important}
}
</style>
<style id="contact-button-final-fix">
.fmwif-top-contact{position:fixed!important;top:12px!important;right:18px!important;z-index:999999!important;}
.fmwif-top-contact a{animation:fmwifPulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite, fmwifBlink 1.7s ease-in-out infinite!important;}
</style>
<style id="final-top-right-contact-fix">
.fmwif-top-contact{
position:fixed !important;
top:15px !important;
right:15px !important;
bottom:auto !important;
left:auto !important;
z-index:2147483647 !important;
display:flex !important;
flex-direction:column !important;
align-items:flex-end !important;
gap:8px !important;
animation:fmwifBlink 1.7s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact a{
animation:fmwifPulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite, fmwifBlink 1.7s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}
</style>
<style id="final-top-right-fix">
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links{
position:fixed !important;
top:15px !important;
right:15px !important;
bottom:auto !important;
left:auto !important;
z-index:999999 !important;
display:flex !important;
flex-direction:column !important;
gap:8px !important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links a{
animation:finalBlink 1.2s infinite !important;
}
@keyframes finalBlink{
0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
50%{opacity:.45;transform:scale(1.08)}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links{top:8px !important;right:8px !important;left:auto !important;bottom:auto !important;}
}
</style>
<style id="one-final-contact-fix">
/* ONE FINAL CONTACT BUTTON POSITION */
.fmwif-top-contact,
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links {
position:fixed !important;
top:20px !important;
right:20px !important;
bottom:auto !important;
left:auto !important;
z-index:2147483647 !important;
display:flex !important;
flex-direction:column !important;
gap:10px !important;
align-items:flex-end !important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact a,
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links a {
animation: oneBlink 1.2s infinite !important;
}
@keyframes oneBlink {
0%,100% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
50% { opacity:.45; transform:scale(1.08); }
}
@media(max-width:700px){
.fmwif-top-contact, .fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links {
top:10px !important; right:10px !important; bottom:auto !important; left:auto !important;
}
}
</style>
</head>

<h3 class="zarqa-name">Zarqa Zulfiqar</h3>
<p><b>Founder | Director | Keynote Speaker | Reviewer</b></p>
<p>Zarqa Zulfiqar is a global keynote speaker and the Founder of Future Minds World Innovative Forum (FMWIF). With a strong research background and a passion for knowledge, innovation and global collaboration, she works to inspire minds and promote the exchange of ideas across the world.</p>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Past Events</title>
<style>
* {
box-sizing: border-box;
}
body {
margin: 0;
font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
background: linear-gradient(135deg, #061a35, #0b4d8c);
color: white;
}
/* Main Container */
.container {
max-width: 1200px;
margin: auto;
padding: 60px 20px 70px;
}
/* Header */
.header {
text-align: center;
margin-bottom: 50px;
}
.badge {
display: inline-block;
padding: 9px 22px;
border-radius: 30px;
background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
font-size: 13px;
letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.header h1 {
margin: 18px 0 10px;
font-size: 55px;
}
.header p {
max-width: 700px;
margin: auto;
color: #d9eaff;
font-size: 18px;
line-height: 1.6;
}
/* Events Grid */
.events {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
gap: 30px;
}
/* Event Card */
.card {
background: white;
color: #162b4d;
border-radius: 20px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.card:hover {
transform: translateY(-8px);
box-shadow: 0 25px 55px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}
/* Event Image */
.card-image {
width: 100%;
height: 430px;
object-fit: cover;
display: block;
cursor: pointer;
}
/* Card Content */
.card-content {
padding: 22px;
}
.card-content h2 {
margin: 0 0 10px;
font-size: 22px;
}
.card-content p {
margin: 0;
color: #64748b;
line-height: 1.5;
}
/* View Button */
.button {
display: inline-block;
margin-top: 18px;
padding: 10px 18px;
background: #0b4d91;
color: white;
text-decoration: none;
border-radius: 8px;
font-weight: bold;
cursor: pointer;
}
.button:hover {
background: #073766;
}
/* Footer */
.footer {
text-align: center;
margin-top: 50px;
color: #bdd4ef;
font-size: 14px;
}
/* Image Popup */
.popup {
display: none;
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(0,0,0,0.93);
z-index: 9999;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
padding: 20px;
}
.popup img {
max-width: 95%;
max-height: 90vh;
object-fit: contain;
}
.close {
position: absolute;
top: 15px;
right: 25px;
color: white;
font-size: 45px;
cursor: pointer;
}
/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
.events {
grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
}
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
.container {
padding: 40px 15px 50px;
}
.header h1 {
font-size: 40px;
}
.events {
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
.card-image {
height: auto;
}
}
</style>
<style id="contact-button-final-fix">
.fmwif-top-contact{position:fixed!important;top:12px!important;right:18px!important;z-index:999999!important;}
.fmwif-top-contact a{animation:fmwifPulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite, fmwifBlink 1.7s ease-in-out infinite!important;}
</style>
<style id="final-top-right-fix">
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links{
position:fixed !important;
top:15px !important;
right:15px !important;
bottom:auto !important;
left:auto !important;
z-index:999999 !important;
display:flex !important;
flex-direction:column !important;
gap:8px !important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links a{
animation:finalBlink 1.2s infinite !important;
}
@keyframes finalBlink{
0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
50%{opacity:.45;transform:scale(1.08)}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links{top:8px !important;right:8px !important;left:auto !important;bottom:auto !important;}
}
</style>
<style id="one-final-contact-fix">
/* ONE FINAL CONTACT BUTTON POSITION */
.fmwif-top-contact,
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links {
position:fixed !important;
top:20px !important;
right:20px !important;
bottom:auto !important;
left:auto !important;
z-index:2147483647 !important;
display:flex !important;
flex-direction:column !important;
gap:10px !important;
align-items:flex-end !important;
}
.fmwif-top-contact a,
.fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links a {
animation: oneBlink 1.2s infinite !important;
}
@keyframes oneBlink {
0%,100% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
50% { opacity:.45; transform:scale(1.08); }
}
@media(max-width:700px){
.fmwif-top-contact, .fmwif-top-contact.floating-contact-links {
top:10px !important; right:10px !important; bottom:auto !important; left:auto !important;
}
}
</style>
</head>

<script id="fmwif-scroll-animation">
/* ===== FMWIF SCROLL REVEAL ===== */
(function(){
const items = document.querySelectorAll(
"section, .box, .partner-card, .speaker, .upcoming-event"
);
items.forEach((el,i)=>{
el.classList.add("fmwif-reveal");
el.style.setProperty("--reveal-delay", Math.min((i%5)*70,280) + "ms");
});
const style=document.createElement("style");
style.textContent=`
.fmwif-reveal{
opacity:0;
transform:translateY(28px);
}
.fmwif-reveal.fmwif-visible{
opacity:1;
transform:translateY(0);
transition:opacity .7s ease var(--reveal-delay),
transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1) var(--reveal-delay);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
.fmwif-reveal,.fmwif-reveal.fmwif-visible{
opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none;
}
}
`;
document.head.appendChild(style);
if(!("IntersectionObserver" in window)){
items.forEach(el=>el.classList.add("fmwif-visible"));
return;
}
const observer=new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
entries.forEach(entry=>{
if(entry.isIntersecting){
entry.target.classList.add("fmwif-visible");
observer.unobserve(entry.target);
}
});
},{threshold:.10,rootMargin:"0px 0px -45px 0px"});
items.forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
})();
</script>
</body>
